name: kumparan
notes: Client-rendered React app with styled-components hashes (never use them); the stable hooks are data-qa-id attributes. Body is main[data-qa-id=article-main], paragraphs p[data-qa-id=story-paragraph], ad slots carry data-qa-id with 'ads'. All story pages are in one page. Article URLs are /<channel>/<slug>-<id> where the id starts with a digit. kumparan.com redirects phones to m.kumparan.com (covered by the domain). No RSS feed (/rss is 404), so the canary uses the samples.
